name: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (宁德时代新能源科技股份有限公司)
summary: CATL is the world's largest lithium-ion battery manufacturer, spun out of ATL in 2011 and listed in Shenzhen (June 2018) and Hong Kong (May 2025 — the HK$41B raise was the world's largest IPO of 2025, with ~90% of proceeds earmarked for the Debrecen, Hungary plant). It supplies EV batteries to most global automakers and utility/C&I energy storage systems worldwide, with the storage business (TENER line) now its fastest-growing segment: ESS revenue grew 87.5% YoY in H1 2026 to nearly 20% of total revenue.
ecosystemRole: No. 1 in global EV power batteries for nine consecutive years (39.2% of 1,187 GWh installed in 2025, SNE Research) and No. 1 in energy-storage batteries for five consecutive years — though the ESS lead narrowed in 2025 (company-reported ESS share 30.4%, down from 36.5%; Benchmark estimates ~20% with Hithium and EVE at ~12% each). ESS battery sales: 93 GWh (2024) → 121 GWh (2025). Anchor storage deployment: sole BESS supplier (19 GWh of TENER) for Masdar's US$6B 5.2 GW round-the-clock solar+storage project in Abu Dhabi — the largest single BESS order to date.

productsAndServices.name: EV power batteries (Qilin, Shenxing)
productsAndServices.description: Core business — 74.7% of FY2025 revenue. Qilin (CTP 3.0) NMC/LFP packs reach 255 Wh/kg system-level; Shenxing and Shenxing Plus superfast-charging LFP support ~4C charging for mass-market EVs. Power battery sales hit 541 GWh in 2025 (+42%).
highlights: Customers include Tesla, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, VW, Toyota, Hyundai, and the major Chinese OEMs

productsAndServices.name: Utility-scale storage (TENER line)
productsAndServices.description: TENER (April 2024) was the world's first mass-producible '5-year zero-degradation' 6.25 MWh 20-ft container; TENER Stack (May 2025) is a 9 MWh dual-stack system on 587Ah cells; TENER Sodium (June 2026) is the first field-validated sodium-ion BESS.
highlights: 19 GWh Masdar Abu Dhabi order — largest single BESS order to date
TENER Sodium launch orders: 60 GWh HyperStrong (3-year), 5 GWh Alfen MoU, 2 GWh Solarpro

productsAndServices.name: C&I / modular storage (EnerOne, EnerD)
productsAndServices.description: EnerOne/EnerOne+ liquid-cooled outdoor LFP cabinets (280Ah cells, ~372 kWh per cabinet); EnerD (2023) was the world's first mass-delivered 5 MWh 20-ft container on 314Ah cells — both precede and complement TENER in global C&I and utility fleets.

productsAndServices.name: Sodium-ion line (Naxtra)
productsAndServices.description: Launched April 2025: EV cell at 175 Wh/kg with 90% usable capacity at -40°C and >10,000 cycles; first sodium-ion battery to pass China's GB 38031-2025 safety standard; mass production from December 2025, including the first mass-production sodium-ion passenger car with Changan.

productsAndServices.name: Battery swap (EVOGO / Choco-SEB)
productsAndServices.description: Standardized 25 kWh Choco-SEB swap blocks (Dec 2024) with a national station network — 1,020 stations in 45 cities by end-2025, the 2,000th station opened June 2026, targeting 3,000 by end-2026; Sinopec partnership targets 500+ co-built stations initially.

productsAndServices.name: Technology licensing (LRS model)
productsAndServices.description: License-Royalty-Service deals monetize CATL IP in markets closed to Chinese investment — flagship: Ford's US$3.5B BlueOval Battery Park Michigan (~35 GWh design capacity) producing CATL-licensed LFP cells from late 2026; similar talks reported with GM and roughly a dozen automakers.

technicalSpecs.product: TENER Stack — 9 MWh dual-stack utility BESS (flagship, May 2025)

specs.label: Energy per system
specs.value: 9 MWh — two stackable half-height containers, each <36 t

specs.label: Volume utilization
specs.value: +45% vs a standard 20-ft container; ~+50% projected energy density

specs.label: Transport
specs.value: Compliant in ~99% of markets via the two-in-one modular design

technicalSpecs.notes: Original TENER (April 2024): 6.25 MWh per 20-ft container, 430 Wh/L, >15,000 cycles, zero capacity/power degradation claimed for the first 5 years.

technicalSpecs.product: TENER Sodium — first field-validated sodium-ion BESS (June 2026)

specs.label: Configuration
specs.value: 30+ MWh per configuration (8 × 3.75 MWh modules, 42 t each); LFP variant of the same architecture reaches 50 MWh

specs.label: Cells
specs.value: Naxtra-family sodium cells (chemistry undisclosed, likely NFPP; cell window 1.5–4.3 V)

specs.label: Cycle life
specs.value: 15,000 cycles @25°C; >10,000 @45°C (to 70% SOH); 25–30-year service life with a 30-year warranty

specs.label: Cold performance
specs.value: >92% capacity retention at -20°C with no active heating

specs.label: Timeline
specs.value: First China deliveries Sept 2026 (~1 GWh in 2026); global from June 2027
